title: Art Center Clay Studio Membership with Raku Firing
source_quote: the studio also offers Raku if you are interested in partaking or just watching
evidence_sentence: Clay Studio members can participate in or watch raku firings offered by the studio.
evidence_quote: the studio also offers Raku if you are interested in partaking or just watching
summary: Join the Clay Studio with a 3-month ($50) or 1-year ($200) membership to access raku firings and other firings in the studio. Members attend an orientation class first and can sign up for studio sessions to work with clay and participate in bisque, glaze, and raku firings.
how_to_join: Complete the Intro to Clay Studio orientation class to activate a three-month membership; ongoing 1-year memberships available for $200.
